200.description: List of datasets. When `status=true` is specified, each dataset includes `status` and error metadata (`error`, `error_message`) when applicable.

schema.description: Dataset information returned by the `/v1/datasets` endpoint.

acceleration_enabled.description: Whether acceleration is enabled for the dataset

oneOf.description:
An optional error type/code for the dataset status.
Only populated when `status=true` and the dataset status is `Error`.
Example:
`{ "category": "dataset", "type": "auth", "code": "dataset.auth" }`.

category.description: High-level component category where the error originated.
category.title: ComponentErrorCategory

type.description: Canonical error type intended for programmatic handling.
type.title: ComponentErrorType

oneOf.title: ComponentError

error_message.description:
An optional error message describing why the dataset entered an error state.
Only populated when `status=true`, the dataset status is `Error`, and an error message was recorded.
This value is intended for user-visible display.

from.description: The source where the dataset is located (e.g., `postgres:syncs`)

replication_enabled.description: Whether replication is enabled for the dataset

oneOf.description:
The current status of the dataset. Only included when `status=true` query parameter is specified.
Possible values: `Initializing`, `Ready`, `Disabled`, `Error`, `Refreshing`, `ShuttingDown`.
The component is initializing and not yet ready
The component is ready to accept connections
The component is disabled and not running
An error occurred in the component, with an optional error message

Error.description: An error occurred in the component, with an optional error message

oneOf.description: The component is in the process of refreshing its state
The component is in the process of shutting down

oneOf.title: String

schema.title: DatasetInfo

example.name: messages_accelerated
example.error_message: Unable to authenticate with datasource credentials

500.description: Internal server error occurred while processing datasets

text/plain.example: An unexpected error occurred while processing datasets
